::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8–10\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 45 minutes

[Dessert]{.badge .badge-dessert} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Just because it was devised in the Depression doesn't mean it isn't delicious!*

## Ingredients

- 3 eggs
- 1½ cups sugar
- 1 tbsp flour
- 6 tsp butter (melted)
- 1 tsp lemon extract
- ½ cup buttermilk
- dash of salt
- ground cinnamon
- ground nutmeg

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 350°F.*

1. Beat the eggs and add the sugar, flour, butter, salt, and lemon extract.
2. Add the buttermilk to the mixture and mix.
3. Pour the mixture into an uncooked pie shell.
4. Dust the top of the pie with cinnamon and nutmeg.
5. Bake for 45 minutes.
